style: Read clearly and naturally, at a moderate pace
lines: Welcome to Imaginary Island. Every spot on this map is a complex number. Drag the lantern anywhere to read its address.
East and west is the Real Road. North and south is the Imaginary Road. The harbor is zero.
Times i swings you a quarter turn counterclockwise around the harbor. Your distance stays the same.
Two quarter turns make a half turn, to the opposite side. That is why i squared is negative one.
Four quarter turns bring you all the way around. So i to the fourth power is one.
Adding is walking. The step w moves you the same distance and direction from anywhere on the island.
Multiplying by w turns you by its heading and stretches you by its distance from the harbor.
The conjugate flips the sign of the imaginary part. On the map, it is a mirror across the Real Road.
Clue Trail. Read the clue, tap where you think it leads, then press Walk it to check.
A number times its conjugate is always real. It equals its distance from the harbor, squared.
Springs. Slide b and c, and watch where the two solutions of the quadratic come up.
The parabola no longer touches the x-axis, so the solutions leave the Real Road. They come up as a mirror pair, one north and one south.
